label: Research pool deep dive F (24 Oct 2026)

payload.writeUp: Deep dive F of 24 October 2026: a fresh look at 22 UK companies already in the pool, re-checking from their own sites, Companies House, platform listings and the press whether each is genuinely raising now, closed, or unknown. Access status found: 5 closed, 1 expected, 6 fundraising reported, 10 unknown. Closed raises are kept so the watch list and timeline stay honest; nothing here is presented as open without a source.

candidate.name: Sorair Technologies
candidate.teaser: Westcott drone-automation platform (Soranet) with UK-wide CAA BVLOS approvals; SH01 allotments in May and Aug 2026, no public round.
candidate.description: Sorair Technologies Ltd (incorporated 28 Oct 2019 as FindMyFitness Ltd, renamed June 2021) sells Soranet, a hardware-agnostic drone-automation platform for site security and inspection, plus Sorair Flight School, which holds a CAA-recognised BVLOS operational authorisation. The site lists Techstars, Haatch, Pi Labs and SFC Capital logos and packages from GBP 5,000 a year. Customers/partners named on readable pages include ASEL and GOLDBECK SOLAR (solar-farm deployment, Feb 2026). Companies House shows SH01 allotments on 20 May 2026 and 18 Aug 2026 after a run of 2024 allotments, so money has been raised recently, but no page states an open round, terms or SEIS/EIS. Accounts are micro-company, so revenue is unknown.
candidate.discoverySignal: Two SH01 filings in 2026 (allotments 20 May and 18 Aug) with RES10/RES11 resolutions, plus CAA BVLOS approvals in 2025.
candidate.researchRuleMatched: Early UK deep-tech with recent allotments; no public route for individuals found.
